scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:claude -w @codexnest/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @codexnest/protocol && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @codexnest/server" "npm run dev -w @codexnest/client"
scripts.dev:claude: npm run build -w @codexnest/protocol && concurrently -k -n claude-api,claude-ui "npm run dev -w @claudenest/server" "npm run dev:claude -w @codexnest/client"
scripts.build:claude: npm run build -w @codexnest/protocol && npm run build -w @claudenest/server && npm run build:claude -w @codexnest/client
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n codex,claude "npm run dev:codex" "npm run dev:claude"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @codexnest/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
